regular_local_hypotheses: F-finite Noetherian regular local ring of characteristic p>0
every I_n for n>=1 is nonzero and proper
I_a I_b subset I_(a+b) for every positive a,b
accepted_conclusion: lim_n n fpt_R(I_n) = sup_n n fpt_R(I_n), in the extended positive reals allowing positive infinity
singular_boundary: F-pure node times a line, non-descending Noetherian graded family; normalized thresholds exactly 2 on positive even indices and 0 on odd indices
scope_blocker: Original AIM primary page unavailable; original ring conventions remain unverified
